title: Legal Notice for Material Breach of Commercial Contract, Specific Performance, and Damages
whenToUse: Use when an enterprise or vendor suffers a material commercial breach of contract, non-payment, milestone default, or failure of service level agreement (SLA) from a corporate partner.
variantComparisonNote: Pre-litigation commercial breach notice under Indian Contract Act, 1872. Distinct from works agreements and summary suits.
youWillNeed: Executed commercial contract / SLA, purchase orders, email correspondence confirming breach, statement of financial losses.
legalBasis: Sections 39, 73, 74 Indian Contract Act, 1872; Specific Relief Act, 1963; Section 12A Commercial Courts Act, 2015.
mandatoryStatutoryIngredients: Details of contractual promises and client's complete readiness and willingness (Section 16(c) SRA)
Specific particulars of default, milestone delays, and breach of essential conditions
Quantification of direct, incidental, and consequential damages under Section 73 Contract Act
Mandatory 15-day cure period notice prior to instituting commercial suit / arbitration

particulars.label: Aggrieved Company / Client Name
particulars.description: Corporate name of client suffering breach

particulars.label: Defaulting Company Name
particulars.description: Corporate name of defaulting partner / vendor

particulars.label: Disputed Amount / Damages (INR)
particulars.description: Aggregated contractual claim and loss sum

aiBlocks.title: Contractual Framework & Client's Performance
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Narrate commercial agreement, agreed scopes, client's readiness and willingness, and fulfillment of reciprocal promises by {{FACT:aggrieved_company_name}}.

aiBlocks.title: Material Breaches & Quantification of Damages
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Detail specific material defaults committed by {{FACT:defaulting_company_name}}, failure of milestones, and direct damages totaling ₹{{FACT:disputed_contract_value}}/- under Section 73 Contract Act.

aiBlocks.title: Peremptory Cure Demand & Dispute Resolution Repercussions
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Call upon defaulting company to cure breaches and remit ₹{{FACT:disputed_contract_value}}/- within 15 days, failing which commercial arbitration or civil suit under SRA will be initiated.
